text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I won the Tenno Sho (Autumn)! I actually 
beat the two I look up to so much, but 
aaaaagh...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to you, Trainer, and every 
single one of the girls who helped bring 
me this far... I just can't stop getting 
so emotional!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I can't, I'm dying. I wuv you so much more 
than before, I'm losing all my 
vocabulary... But, but, just let me say 
this one last thing!!
